text:
Alex M.: Heads up — scheduling a targeted maintenance window for AZ-east1 bridge route refresh + staggered GPU pool drain Sun 02:00-05:00 UTC. Goal: apply nvlink kernel fix and reboot affected racks without causing cross-region egress spikes.
Maria C.: How many racks/pods are in scope? impact to hosted API / Dedicated?
Alex M.: ~6 racks (batch + hosted-burst). Expected capacity hit ~18% in AZ-east1; global effect minimal due to smart routing. Dedicated pinned pools only affected if on those racks — we'll produce tenant list.
Rahul P.: Paste exact node IDs pls. Also we'll preseed KV caches for top prefixes 1h before drain.
Alex M.: Node list: r-ae-231 r-ae-232 r-ae-233 r-ae-234 r-ae-235 r-ae-236. Preseed: rwctl kv seed --pool=hosted-burst --prefix-file=top20.txt scheduled T-60m.
SRE Oncall: Rollback criteria: if 95p latency >200ms for 10m OR error rate +200% -> abort and revert route-table. Alert if pod restarts >3/min.
Maria C.: Need comms copy for status page + support playbook.
Alex M.: Draft: "Planned network + kernel maintenance in AZ-east1 Sun 02:00-05:00 UTC. Some requests may route to nearby regions; Dedicated customers on affected racks will be contacted. Expect short reconnects; we will rollback on significant impact"
Rahul P.: Ops runbook snippet:
```
# staggered drain per rack
for rack in r-ae-231 r-ae-232 r-ae-233 r-ae-234 r-ae-235 r-ae-236; do
  rwctl pool cordon --rack=$rack --reason="nvlink-fix"
  rwctl pool drain --rack=$rack --grace=300
  wait-for-empty --rack $rack --timeout 1800
  ssh admin@$rack "sudo /usr/bin/kernel-upgrade && sudo reboot"
  sleep 600
done
```
Maria C.: Support playbook: check routing -> failover to AZ-west2 if latency spikes; verify tenant pins; update status page if customers see errors.
SRE Oncall: Canary rack = r-ae-231. Run for 30m, validate 95p delta <30ms and no error increase. If canary fails revert and abort.
ops-bot: Maintenance created MW-2026-az-east1-bridge (1965004322 -> 1965015522).
Rahul P.: Cost note: cross-region fallback will add egress. Estimate: 5% traffic -> ~1.2TB extra (~$90). Tag cost center INF-MW-420. Recommend reserving 4xA100 standby in AZ-east1 to limit egress.
Alex M.: Tagging done. @Rahul P. please reserve standby GPUs and bind to hosted-burst for preseed.
Rahul P.: Confirmed reserve 4xA100 standby. Preseed target configured.
Maria C.: I'll draft customer email after tenant list. Creating internal triage channel #mw-az-east1.
SRE Oncall: I'll wire PagerDuty and health-runbook. Who owns post-maint checks?
Alex M.: I'll own first 2 hours of post-maint health checks (latency/throughput/kv-hit-rate); SRE Oncall takes over for escalations.
Maria C.: All set — update infra ticket with node IDs and comms.
Alex M.: Done. TL;DR: Sun 02:00-05:00 UTC, AZ-east1 targeted rack reboots, canary r-ae-231, standby GPUs reserved, KV preseed + rollback thresholds. Thanks :thumbsup:
